title: Paloma and the Contact
author: Emrys Blackwood
blurb: August Coldharbour, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
